purpose: Index of every wireframe in this library. Read this file first, match the requested screen to the nearest entry, then read only that file. Do not read the full wireframes/ tree up front.

layouts.name: home-map
layouts.purpose: Default landing screen. Rider sets pickup/destination, map-first.

layouts.name: ride-confirm
layouts.purpose: Pickup/dropoff locked in, single fare shown, one Book action. Never show multiple ride-tier options — this is a one-fare app.

layouts.name: active-trip
layouts.purpose: Live tracking — driver en route or trip in progress. Always exactly one driver-card.

layouts.name: trip-history
layouts.purpose: List of past trips, most recent first. No map.

layouts.name: profile
layouts.purpose: Rider account settings. Form-and-list layout, no map.

sections.name: map-header
sections.purpose: Full-bleed map area behind the bottom sheet. Exactly one driver pin — never a cluster.

sections.name: bottom-sheet
sections.purpose: Rounded-top scrollable content surface under the map. Primary content container for ride-flow screens.

sections.name: fare-breakdown
sections.purpose: Itemized fare list. Flat/tiered pricing only — never a surge or dynamic-pricing line.

components.name: buttons
components.purpose: Primary (royal), secondary (outline), and destructive (red) button variants.
components.note: Destructive variant is reserved for cancel/sign-out/no-show actions only, never a default CTA.

components.name: card
components.purpose: Generic rounded content card — base for receipts, saved places, info panels.

components.name: pill-badge
components.purpose: Short status labels. Variants: success (green), neutral (gray), danger (red).

components.name: bottom-nav
components.purpose: Persistent 3-item bottom nav (Ride / Activity / Account). Fixed at the app-shell level, not per-page. Do not add a 4th item without a product decision — this app intentionally has a minimal nav.

components.name: driver-card
components.purpose: Represents the single assigned driver. Never render this as a list — BLAQ has one driver, one car, one fare at a time.

components.name: rating-stars
components.purpose: 5-star rider-to-driver rating input, filled state uses royal blue.
